text: cortex R3: `cortex repair --max-proposals N --deadline-ms N` bound the whole walk (one counter across both passes; deadline from cortex start); once either is spent no generator is asked anything again, a cmd: generator is cut at the deadline, an ai: call is not started without its 30 s timeout left, the audit is skipped, and the run ends budget_exhausted (exit 20) with detail proposals|deadline and a budget block in --json. Unset by default.
